causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand in Victoria peaked at a new record of 9012 MW and was close to record levels in South Australia.

causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Peak demand in Victoria was also 600 MW higher than forecast four hours ahead and 500 MW higher than forecast twelve hours ahead.

causes.label: scheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Up to 1100 MW of generator capacity, including 200 MW of Victorian hydro plant, 400 MW of coal plant at Yallourn and Morwell on maintenance, and 475 MW at Newport, was not offered into the market.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding the previous day by Loy Yang Management Co saw 335 MW of capacity at Loy Yang A repriced to above $5000/MWh.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Actual flows across all interconnectors into Victoria (across Snowy, Heywood and Bass link) were approaching their maximum capabilities.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: At 3.02 pm, bushfires in north east Victoria and in the vicinity of the fully loaded transmission lines from the Snowy region caused a number of those lines to automatically open, severing the connection to Melbourne.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: At 4.20 pm, NEMMCO overrode the spot price in Victoria setting the price to $10,000/MWh for the next two hours.
